parts:

Is there any way to estimate species richness through the unmarked frame?
If that is the case, is it possible to account for sampling effort?
Best,

messages.author: 681fb59733e01a1e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Species richness in unmarked
parts:
hi Manuel,
 At this point we don't have any features for species richness modeling. That said, it is on our list of things to do. For now you can grab some R code off of the Royle/Dorazio book website (www.hierarchicalmodeling.com) for fitting single-community models.  For meta-community problems see chapter 12.
regards
andy

unmarked: A very useful R package for fitting certain hierarchical models using likelihood methods. Available from: http://cran.case.edu/web/packages/unmarked/index.html
